'''R2-R9''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that served the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. It was onboard the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] when [[Queen/Legends]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] used the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to flee from Naboo. When the starship took damage from Trade Federation fire, R2-R9 and several other [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] traveled to the ship's exterior to try and repair damage to the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. While trying to carry out repairs, R2-R9 was struck by enemy fire and destroyed.

==Biography==
===Escaping Naboo===
{{Quote|Hello, boyos.|Jar Jar Binks greets R2-R9 and the other astromechs|audio=Binks-HelloBoyos.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Naboo_Royal_Starship.png|thumb|left|250px|R2-R9 escaped Naboo onboard the Naboo Royal Starship.]]
The [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] designated R2-R9 served the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the reign of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="TPM" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Naboo was [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was captured. With the aid of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Amidala and some of her staff managed to escape from the Federation and board the [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship|J-type 327 Nubian]] [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|Royal Starship]] in one of the hangars of the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. R2-R9 was one of at least five [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] on board the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] when it departed the hangar to try and escape Naboo.<ref name="TPM" />

As the starship left Naboo's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], Kenobi brought the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] down to the room in the starship where R2-R9 and the other astromechs were docked and told him to wait there. The royal starship then came under fire from Trade Federation<ref name="TPM" /> [[Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighter/Legends|Lucrehulk-class LH-3210 cargo freighters]]<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> blockading the planet.

===Lost in the line of duty===
{{Quote|We're losing droids, fast.|Obi-Wan Kenobi comments on R2-R9's destruction|audio=Kenobi-LosingDroids.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:R2-R9_death.png|thumb|right|250px|R2-R9 was destroyed while trying to repair the Naboo Royal Starship.]]
A shot from one of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] damaged the Royal Starship's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] which set off an alarm in the room the astromechs were waiting in. R2-R9 and the other [[droid]]s immediately left their docking stations and rolled over to a lift that would take them to ship's exterior. R2-R9 was second onto the surface after<ref name="TPM" /> [[G8-R3/Legends|G8-R3]]<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> and the droids quickly set about attempting repairs.<ref name="TPM" />

As [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]&mdash;the last droid to reach the ship's exterior&mdash;reached the damaged generator, R2-R9 was struck by a shot from one of the Trade Federation vessels and [[Death/Legends|destroyed]]. Each of the other droids were then picked off one by one until only R2-D2 remained; however, he was able to complete the repairs to the generator and save the ship, which successfully escaped the blockade.<ref name="TPM" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:R2R9.png|thumb|250px|R2-R9 on the Royal Starship]]
R2-R9 was an [[R-series/Legends|R-series]]<ref name="30 Ann Coll" /> astromech droid with [[Color/Legends|red]] and silver paneling.<ref name="TPM" /> Like all R2 units it was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and stood 0.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall. Like other members of its model make, it demonstrated great bravery in the face of danger, as evidenced by its last moments being to risk exposing itself to turbolaser blasts to fix the ship.<ref name="30 Ann Coll" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-R9 first appeared in the film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPM" /> which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]]. The droid was not named in the film,<ref name="TPM" /> but first received identification in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] (at the time considered the canonical Expanded Universe) ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide]]''<ref name="Insider's Guide" /> released on [[June 23]], 1999.<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news19990623.html|text=''Star Wars:'' Episode I ''Insider's Guide''}}</ref>
